title: @inth/sdk-ui: Cookie consent UI primitives and theme system
description: The framework-agnostic cookie consent UI primitives, CSS, and theme tokens behind the inth React, Vue, Svelte, and Astro components. Most apps get this package through a framework adapter and do not install it directly.
features: One theme system for every inth framework: set `--inth-*` tokens once and the banner, dialog, and preference center follow
Stylesheets for plain CSS and Tailwind CSS, with a separate file for Tailwind CSS 3
Framework-agnostic primitives for building a inth adapter for another UI framework
manualInstallation: The framework packages (`@inth/react`, `@inth/vue`, `@inth/astro`, `@inth/svelte`) depend on this package and re-export its stylesheets. Install it directly only to build your own adapter:
